name: Net Isoplot
description: Heatmap of along-copper distance from a selected pad/via to its net
description_full: Select any pad or via and run the plugin: it computes the geodesic (along-copper) distance from the selection to every reachable point on the same net, across all copper layers (connected through vias), and draws a colour heatmap overlay with a legend. Blue marks points near the selection, red marks the furthest points - a quick visual aid for spotting and shortening current loops. Works with zero external dependencies (pure Python + bundled wxPython); uses NumPy automatically for a finer/faster result when it is installed.
